description.text: The Modern Logistics School consists of Logistics and Information Management Department, offering three bachelor degrees including logistics management, information management and information system, e-commerce. Logistics management is the national level specialty and information management and information system is the Zhejiang provincial key specialty. There are 45 teaching staff including one member of Teaching Steering Committee of National Ministry of Education, one Yongjiang scholar Professor, 6 professors and 12 associate professors. The teachers with senior achievements accounts for 45% of faculty. Modern Logistics School aims to become a leading logistics school in the Yangtze River Delta with distinctive characteristics specialty and professions with logistics specialty and expertise as platform, information technology as the core and information platform construction as support in order to cultivate high-end undergraduate and industry personnel closely cooperating with industry.Modern Logistics School shoulders the construction of key specialty group with logistics service type in Ningbo city and owns the commerce and logistics lab financed by the provincial financial bureau. It builds the economics and management Laboratory Center jointly with Business School. The experimental area is 800 square meters, instruments and equipment are about 850 sets, including port logistics laboratory, ERP laboratory, information management laboratory, logistics management laboratory, e-commerce lab, business laboratory, international trade laboratory, quality evaluation laboratory, accounting and financial market integration laboratory . It has formed experimental teaching system of basic, professional, comprehensive and practical four levels. It has established the training bases in many logistics enterprises and IT companies as well. The Modern Logistics School attaches great importance to cultivate the innovation and entrepreneurship awareness and practical ability of students, who have achieved excellent results in various contests such as first "creativity, innovation and entrepreneurship " E-commerce contest, national undergraduates ERP Sand Table Tournament, "Challenge Cup" Business Plan Competition by Zhejiang Province and so on. The undergraduates have got eight the provincial research and undertaking programs, published over 50 papers and awarded over 10 patents and software copyrights. The graduates are warmly welcomed by the society. Every year the one time employment rate for the bachelors can reach over 95%. Besides, over 100 students further their study abroad and over 30 students set up companies. Bachelor Specialty Department Specialty Conferred Degree Logistics Management Logistics Management Management Information Management Information Management and Information System Management Information Management E-commerce Management

duration.text: The Logistics Management at Zhejiang Wanli University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1388 USD/per semester ￥ 10000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
